title: Custom Body Butter Making Class in Frisco
includes: all ingredients and containers are included and each guest takes home one 8oz body butter.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Kids 5 and up welcome if accompanied by an adult
alcohol is served only to guests 21+ with valid photo ID
policies: Plant and nut oils used so we recommend patch testing for sensitive skin
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Craft your own luxurious 8oz body butter in this unique 1 hour class in Frisco. Under the guidance of skilled instructors, explore the art of using high-quality plant-based oils and essential oils tailored to your skin's needs. With the opportunity to mix over 60 delightful fragrances, create a custom scent that reflects your personality. Enjoy a complimentary beverage as you immerse yourself in this sensory experience, ensuring your skin receives the pampering it deserves. This hour-long class is perfect for anyone looking to indulge in self-care while learning the secrets of skincare formulation.
